components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main page action on light surfaces.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 3.25rem; padding: .7rem 1.25rem; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--color-dark, #0a0a0a); color: var(--color-dark-text, #f3f3f0); font: 650 .95rem/1 Geist, Arial, sans-serif; transition: color 160ms, background 160ms, transform 160ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-accent, #c6f63d); color: var(--color-dark, #0a0a0a); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(.98); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fff; outline-offset: 4px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 5px var(--color-text-primary, #0a0a0a); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Secondary action with equal touch affordance and lower initial emphasis.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 3.25rem; padding: .7rem 1.25rem; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 1px solid var(--color-border-strong, #8a8a84); border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; color: var(--color-text-primary, #0a0a0a); font: 650 .95rem/1 Geist, Arial, sans-serif; transition: color 160ms, background 160ms, border-color 160ms, transform 160ms; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--color-dark, #0a0a0a); background: var(--color-dark, #0a0a0a); color: var(--color-dark-text, #f3f3f0); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: scale(.98); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fff; outline-offset: 4px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 5px var(--color-text-primary, #0a0a0a); }

components.name: Availability Badge
components.description: Compact availability signal above the hero statement.
components.html: Available for select freelance projects
components.css: .ds-availability { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .65rem; color: var(--color-text-secondary, #4f4f4b); font: 590 .84rem/1.2 Geist, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-availability i { width: .62rem; height: .62rem; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--color-accent, #c6f63d); box-shadow: 0 0 0 .35rem var(--color-accent-soft, #ecf9c9); }

components.name: Floating Navigation
components.description: Sticky, translucent navigation that remains stable while the page scrolls.
components.html: HGWorkServicesStart a project
components.css: .ds-nav { min-height: 3.75rem; padding: .45rem .45rem .45rem .8rem; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 1.5rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-border, #dadad5); border-radius: 1rem; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-surface, #fff) 93%, transparent); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(10,10,10,.04), 0 12px 32px rgba(10,10,10,.06); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); font: 550 .9rem/1 Geist, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-nav a { color: var(--color-text-secondary, #4f4f4b); text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav a:hover { color: var(--color-text-primary, #0a0a0a); } .ds-mark { width: 2.6rem; height: 2.6rem; display: grid; place-items: center; border: 1px solid #0a0a0a; border-radius: .55rem; font-weight: 750; } .ds-nav-cta { margin-left: auto; padding: .9rem 1.1rem; border-radius: 999px; background: #0a0a0a; color: #f3f3f0 !important; } .ds-nav-cta:hover { background: #c6f63d; color: #0a0a0a !important; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fff; outline-offset: 4px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 5px #0a0a0a; }

components.name: Product Frame
components.description: Primary visual proof surface for real screenshots or clearly labeled provisional UI.
components.css: .ds-product-frame { aspect-ratio: 16/10; overflow: hidden; margin: 0; border: 1px solid #dadad5; border-radius: 1.5rem; background: #f7f7f4; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(10,10,10,.04), 0 12px 32px rgba(10,10,10,.06); color: #0a0a0a; font-family: Geist, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-product-chrome { height: 2.6rem; padding: 0 .8rem; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .35rem; border-bottom: 1px solid #deded8; background: #fff; } .ds-product-chrome i { width: .42rem; height: .42rem; border-radius: 50%; background: #d2d2cb; } .ds-product-chrome span { margin-left: .5rem; font-size: .66rem; font-weight: 660; } .ds-product-body { height: calc(100% - 2.6rem); display: grid; place-items: center; color: #4f4f4b; } .ds-product-frame:hover { transform: scale(1.012); transition: transform 320ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-product-frame:focus-within { outline: 2px solid #fff; outline-offset: 4px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 5px #0a0a0a; }

narrative.overview: The system combines the editorial confidence of a considered publication with the clarity of a focused software studio. Large type establishes the proposition; thin rules, operational diagrams, and authored product views provide evidence. The atmosphere is warm, exact, spacious, and grounded in real product work. The visitor path is proposition to product proof to case studies to capability to person to contact.
keyCharacteristics: Warm editorial canvas with near-black ink.
Oversized, compact headlines paired with calm body copy.
Flat surfaces organized by borders, rhythm, and contrast.
Product interfaces shown as evidence, never decorative devices.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Lime occupies a small portion of each viewport and always appears with dark text.

rules.name: The Proof, Not Decoration Rule
rules.body: Product-specific orange appears only inside the CEM interface illustration; it is not a second site accent.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Do not introduce display serif or monospace styling to simulate editorial or technical credibility.

rules.name: The Scale Carries Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Weight changes remain narrow; size, placement, and whitespace do most of the work.

rules.name: The Border Before Shadow Rule
rules.body: Add structure with tone or a one-pixel rule before considering elevation.

dos: Do lead with concrete product work and operational detail.
Do use large type, whitespace, and thin rules to establish hierarchy.
Do label illustrative UI and withhold metrics or testimonials until evidence is approved.
Do keep motion at or under 600 ms, with the longest duration reserved for the opening reveal.
Do preserve visible focus, reduced motion, and 44 px touch targets.
donts: Don't turn every content group into a floating card or bento tile.
Don't add gradients, glassmorphism, 3D device renders, terminal motifs, or decorative tech logos.
Don't introduce parallax, scroll hijacking, autoplay carousels, pointer tilt, or cursor replacement.
Don't use unverified metrics, endorsements, screenshots, clients, or production links.
Don't let the personal profile appear before the product evidence.
